title: Great practice
content: During these testing times this surgery has not failed in looking after me as a patient and my children. Wether a phone appointment or a face to face i never have to wait long and the doctors go above and beyond to help me and any illness. Im grateful that this is my practice as i have heard nothing but negative comments from others about there practices so makes me extremely grateful that i have been lucky enough to be a patient at this surgery. Reception staff also do amazing with responding to e mails and referring me to the doctor when required.
real_data_note: Verbatim real patient review (4-5 star), used as a positive practice exemplar for retrieval grounding. Not an authored policy document.
